description: OMENZ Market job desk: tell OMENZ the JOB ('token price', 'weather by city', 'company enrichment by domain'). We search ~35,000 x402 endpoints, live-probe the matches (unpaid), and rank WORKING providers by live price and latency, each with its OMENZ-verified history (purchases checked, delivery rate, verified sales), plus settlement economics and a ready-to-send Transaction Guard request for the pick. Then guard -> pay -> checkout/close -> (settlement/rescue if weird). Want it guarded in the same call? POST market/job/guarded ($0.05). Never pays a provider. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/job, $0.01 via x402.)
